concept.cypher: MATCH (instance:JMolecules:Stereotype:Instance)-[:DEFINED_BY]->(definition:JMolecules:Stereotype:Definition), (instance)-[:IMPLEMENTED_BY]->(type:Java:Type) RETURN definition as StereotypeDefinition, instance as StereotypeInstance, type AS Type ORDER BY definition.name, instance.name, type.fqn

MATCH (definition:JMolecules:Stereotype:Definition)-[:HAS_ASSIGNMENT]->(assignment:JMolecules:Stereotype:Assignment{type:"ASSIGNABLE_FROM"}), (stereotypeInterface:Type{fqn:assignment.value})-[:ASSIGNABLE_FROM]->(outerType:Java:Type) WHERE outerType.name <> "package-info" and outerType <> stereotypeInterface WITH definition, outerType MATCH (outerType)-[:DECLARES*0..]->(type:Java:Type) MERGE (instance:JMolecules:Stereotype:Instance{name:outerType.fqn}) MERGE (instance)-[:DEFINED_BY]->(definition) MERGE (instance)-[:IMPLEMENTED_BY]->(type) RETURN definition as StereotypeDefinition, instance as StereotypeInstance, type AS Type ORDER BY definition.name, instance.name, type.fqn

MATCH (definition:JMolecules:Stereotype:Definition)-[:HAS_ASSIGNMENT]->(assignment:JMolecules:Stereotype:Assignment{type:"ANNOTATED_BY"}), (outerType:Java:Type)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(:Type{fqn:assignment.value}), (outerType)-[:DECLARES*0..]->(type:Java:Type) WHERE outerType.name <> "package-info" OPTIONAL MATCH (annotation)-[:HAS]->(name:Primitive:Value) WITH definition, type, coalesce(name.value, outerType.fqn) as name MERGE (instance:JMolecules:Stereotype:Instance{name:name}) MERGE (instance)-[:DEFINED_BY]->(definition) MERGE (instance)-[:IMPLEMENTED_BY]-(type) RETURN definition as StereotypeDefinition, instance as StereotypeInstance, type AS Type ORDER BY definition.name, instance.name, type.fqn

MATCH (definition:JMolecules:Stereotype:Definition)-[:HAS_ASSIGNMENT]->(assignment:JMolecules:Stereotype:Assignment{type:"ANNOTATED_BY"}), (package:Java:Package)-[:CONTAINS]->(:Java:Type{name: "package-info"})-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->(annotation)-[:OF_TYPE]->(:Type{fqn:assignment.value}), (package)-[:CONTAINS*]->(type:Java:Type) OPTIONAL MATCH (annotation)-[:HAS]->(name:Primitive:Value) WITH definition, type, coalesce(name.value, package.fqn) as name MERGE (instance:JMolecules:Stereotype:Instance{name:name}) MERGE (instance)-[:DEFINED_BY]->(definition) MERGE (instance)-[:IMPLEMENTED_BY]-(type) RETURN definition as StereotypeDefinition, instance as StereotypeInstance, type AS Type ORDER BY definition.name, instance.name, type.fqn
